integration.runtimeObservation: Author-run isolated chains; hashes identify retained execution receipts, not independent execution attestations

limitations: Two separate one-shot vaults sharing the same isolated Monero/Ergo fixtures and bridged asset
Pure arithmetic requires caller-authenticated facts; packaged observations are recorded evidence, not chain authentication
Selected-input residual under twelve-decimal one-to-one backing, excluding unselected outputs and other possible claims
Deposit fee tokens already issued; return fee entitlement remains pending-reward without completed reward distribution
Ergo operation fees and donor Monero fees separate; fixture setup and mining costs excluded
Fixture fee parameters do not cover observed withdrawal miner costs; test reserves subsidize the difference
Four credit guards share one JavaScript host; native holders use separate processes
No pooled-vault solvency, sustainable fee policy, production deployment or independent operator reproduction claim
